links.outcome: Adenoma detection rate with real-time CADe versus traditional colonoscopy in randomized trial
links.effect: ADR 42.5% vs 34.4% (P = .005); mean APC 0.89 vs 0.60 (P < .001); ADR benefit attenuated in second half of study (38.7% vs 34.9%; P = .33).
links.quote: The ADR for the CADe group was significantly higher than the traditional colonoscopy group (42.5% vs 34.4%; P = .005).

screen.reason: Pragmatic randomized controlled trial evaluating the clinical efficacy of a real-time computer-aided detection (CADe) tool during live colonoscopies compared to traditional colonoscopy alone.
